text.en: Precision final blows generate a lightning bolt at the target's location.
Precision Kills summon a lightning strike that deals <pve 588 /> <pvp [300] /> damage in a 5 meter radius and grants x5 <arc/>Bolt Charge.

Precision Kills summon a lightning strike that deals <pve 973 /> <pvp [300] /> damage in a 7 meter radius and grants x5 <arc/>Bolt Charge.

Lightning strike has damage falloff and deals 0% damage at the edge of its radius.
